prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a single premium fantasy action RPG OVERHEAD CHARACTER TITLE ornament sprite, isolated with true transparent background, intended to display only about 320 x 92 pixels above a final-tier black-gold armored sovereign.
Create an original elegant, imposing Korean action-RPG title insignia with the craftsmanship of a top-tier reward nameplate, not a logo and not a rectangular UI panel.
Composition: WIDE horizontal ornament, about 4:1 visible silhouette, centered with transparent padding on all sides. Front view, symmetrical. A small sharply sculpted black-gold five-point imperial crown sits above the center with one deep crimson ruby. Delicate blade-like gold wings sweep out to both sides, dark obsidian recesses, warm satin champagne-gold bevels and tiny crimson accents. Fine engraved metal structure, clean distinct silhouette at small scale, restrained red ember flourish outside the metal. Two short hanging gold spearhead details under the sides only.
Reserve a very clear, unobstructed horizontal area through the middle-lower region for a SINGLE line of Korean title text added later in the game. This center can have a very subtle almost-black translucent backing haze, but no opaque wide rectangle and no thick bottom bar. The crown and wing ornament should frame the text area without crossing it.
Color palette: obsidian black, champagne gold, deep ruby crimson. Controlled luminous edges, clear metal, no chrome glare, no overwhelming white bloom. Painterly polished 2D game item art, not flat vector clip art.
The ENTIRE ornament must be inside the image, no cut-off tips. Actual transparent alpha background. NO text, NO letters, NO numbers, NO logo, NO watermark, NO character, NO weapon held by a character, NO landscape, NO sheet with multiple objects. Exactly one finished title ornament.
processing: Byte-identical copy. Original generated alpha preserved. Korean lettering is rendered separately using the existing OFL font.
